headline: Introduces the Star Trek-inspired Make It So theme featuring LCARS styling and transporter animations.

entries.title: Make It So theme
entries.details: Adds a Star Trek-inspired theme featuring an LCARS frame, pastel accents, a holodeck grid background, and a comm badge close button. Windows beam in and out with animated transporter effects that can be toggled in the animation settings. The background particle setting has also been renamed to Snow, Leaves and Stars to reflect the new warp star streaks.
